data: Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

The most distant human-made object — over 25 billion kilometers from the Sun and growing. Crossed the heliopause into interstellar space on August 25, 2012. Carries the Golden Record. Still transmitting on its 470 W RTG.
Most distant human-made object — currently ~170 AU from the Sun in interstellar space
Only spacecraft to visit all four giant planets
Companion orbiter to Viking-1 lander — relay + 50000 surface images at 150-300 m/pixel, the first global Mars map. Operated 1976-1980
First spacecraft to encounter Saturn — Jupiter flyby in 1974 then gravity-assist to Saturn in 1979
First spacecraft to traverse the asteroid belt
First spacecraft to orbit another planet
Third US lunar orbiter (1967-02-08). Photographed Surveyor 1 sitting on the lunar surface — first photo of a spacecraft on another world
